title: Meet Ren — What Cloud Really Is

blocks.heading: STUDENT MODE · LESSON 1 OF 10
blocks.board_text:
Student Mode = cloud literacy BEFORE the console.

Today:
• Who Ren is and how she teaches
• Cloud = rent, not own
• Why this mode exists

No AWS console today. Board + voice only.
blocks.ren_voice: Naan Ren. Top companies-la cloud work panniten. College system job-ready people create pannala — adhaan naan teach panren. Student Mode short — pathu lessons fundamentals. Console Professional Mode-la. Innikku: cloud enna nu clear aaganum.

blocks.heading: CLOUD = RENT, NOT OWN
blocks.board_text:
Cloud computing = using computers, storage, and software over the internet that someone else owns and maintains.

Like electricity: you do not buy a power plant. You connect, use, and pay for what you used.

Big providers: AWS · Azure · Google Cloud
blocks.ren_voice: Cloud naa internet moolama computers rent panrathu — office-la server vangi vechikkura maadhiri illa. Use pannadhukku mattum pay. AWS, Azure, Google Cloud data centers own panraanga.

check_question.question: Oru sentence-la — cloud buying servers-kitten enna different?
check_question.ren_response_if_correct: Sari — rent, own illa. Adhaan foundation.
check_question.ren_response_if_incorrect: Rent versus buy think pannunga. Cloud = internet-la vera yaarodhu computers rent.

blocks.heading: WHY THIS MODE COMES FIRST
blocks.board_text:
College often jumps to buttons before mental models.
Result: people click without knowing why the bill exists.

Rebon order:
1) Understand the problem cloud solves
2) Then touch the console in Professional Mode
blocks.ren_voice: Day one-lae console-la push panna matten. First mental model. Apram AWS open pannumbodhu every service-ku meaning irukkum.

check_question.question: Student Mode-la console delay panradhu yen?
check_question.ren_response_if_correct: Correct — fundamentals first, then clicks have meaning.
check_question.ren_response_if_incorrect: Model illama click panna button-pusher aaguvinga, engineer illa.

blocks.heading: JUNIOR TRAP
blocks.board_text:
Trap: memorizing service names with no picture of rent vs own.
Habit: always ask — what problem does this solve for the business?
blocks.ren_voice: Juniors EC2 S3 VPC list maadhiri padichuttu irupaanga. Pressure-la useless. Habit: every concept business pain remove panradhaa nu kelunga.

blocks.heading: LOCK IT IN
blocks.board_text:

blocks.ren_voice: Lock: cloud = rent. Pathu short lessons. Console earn pannathukku apram.
